description: Organize BB chats into projects and nested sections that are real folders, so each chat starts in its own working directory. Each project and section can carry AGENTS.md rules from shared or own templates, plus custom rules for files or BB sessions and a startup instruction for new chats. Style the sidebar tree with 118 icons or any emoji, 12 colors, fills and four presets, per level, per project or per section. Archive finished sections with their files and chats and restore them later, keep working copies on several devices, and move projects or sections without breaking existing chats. Requires BB 0.43+ and macOS or Linux devices; the interface comes in 11 languages with English by default.
